description:
[Deterministic statutory audit. Pure calculation, read-only, side-effect free]. Full bidirectional Italian Codice Fiscale audit under D.M. 23/12/1976: mathematical CIN check character validation, reverse demographic extraction (gender, birthdate, Belfiore cadastral municipality code), omocodia substitution detection, and dehomocoding.
Usage: Use this tool to audit 16-character Italian fiscal codes or decode demographic attributes. For VAT number verification and company KYB, use 'vies_gleif_kyb_verify' instead.
Returns: JSON object with { isValid: boolean, isOmocodia: boolean, normalizedCf: string, demographics: { birthDate: string, gender: 'M' | 'F', belfioreCode: string, municipality: string }, cinValid: boolean }.

codiceFiscale.description: 16-character alphanumeric personal Codice Fiscale or 11-digit legal entity code

expectedBelfioreCode.description: Expected Belfiore cadastral code (e.g. H501 for Roma, F205 for Milano)

expectedBirthDate.description: Expected birth date in YYYY-MM-DD format for consistency check

name: codice_fiscale_audit
